title: Parameter estimation for graphon-interacting particle systems from discrete observations
summary: In this paper, we address the joint parameter estimation of drift and diffusion coefficients for heterogeneously interacting particle systems. Unlike the homogeneous setting, the interactions are governed by a graphon-weighted mean-field framework, which introduces significant analytical complexity: while homogeneous systems yield i.i.d. limits, our setting results in particles that are independent but non-identically distributed in the limit.
